source: Ed4 C.6.5 and C.6.6, pp.C-71 to C-73; C.7.6.3, pp.C-120 to C-122; corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6
description: With the probe, a burst with D_PDU errors at or under rx_error_limit_ppt does not let the estimate move MAX-SPEED down; LOW-SPEED still moves.
note: Table (corpus-format.md 6.1) as drc-rx-trial-after-clean-run with probe_run 3. Flow as drc-rx-trial-after-clean-run, whose table this is with probe_run 3 added: conn 1 binds SAP 5; at 1000 to 3000 a burst holding a PADDING from 0.0.1.3 to us with CAPABILITY (Ed4 1), EOT 10, records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (C-1261); the request at 1500 queues "hello" for 0.0.1.3; at 52000 one transmission (WN 2 Long) holds the type 7 and 20 PADDING D_PDUs, all to 0.0.1.3, whose 21 EOWs are the top priority of Table C-25 (MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED), then SENDER-APPROACH 0xB04, then the rotation MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED, MAX-SEGMENT 0xAFF from its start (interp C-1260, C-1286). Earlier bursts (burst_started, bytes_received 30 ms later, burst_ended 60 ms later) hold a PADDING with EOT 0 (C-0105), or a type 7 to us whose data CRC fails (a D_PDU error, C-0836). Codes: MAX-SPEED 0x8A0 + WN and LOW-SPEED 0x9A0 + WN at Long (C-0462, C-0469). Table positions: WN 2, 4, 6, 7 Long are 0 to 3; bulk thresholds on WN 4 Long -100, 0, 100, 150, on WN 6 Long -100, 0, 300, 500, on WN 7 Long -100, -50, 100, 400; latency on WN 4 Long -100, 100, 300, 400, on WN 6 Long -100, 200, 400, 600, on WN 7 Long -100, 0, 300, 600; smoothing weight 8, clean run 2, error limit 500 ppt, caps 2 doubling to 8. The probe (corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6, interp C-1291) is for MAX-SPEED only. At 100 a clean burst on WN 7 Long, estimate 450: MAX-SPEED WN 7 Long, LOW-SPEED WN 6 Long (as drc-rx-clean-burst-holds-against-estimate). At 200 a burst on WN 7 Long, estimate -300, holds a PADDING and a type 7 whose data CRC fails: h = 2, e = 1, and 1 x 1000 is not above 500 x 2, so no cap, but the burst is not clean: WN 7 Long's clean run goes to 0. S = 75 (d = -750, q = 375), bulk target 1 and latency target 1. With the probe the estimate moves MAX-SPEED down only after a burst over the error limit, e x 1000 > rx_error_limit_ppt x h (interp C-1291, revised corpus 0.34.0, P7-9d), and this one is not, so MAX-SPEED stays WN 7 Long; LOW-SPEED keeps the walk and moves down at once to WN 4 Long (interp C-1270). The CAPABILITY burst, clean, on WN 4 Long, estimate 100: S = 100 on WN 4 Long; bulk target 2 (100; 150 is above) is below MAX-SPEED, but the burst is clean, so MAX-SPEED holds; it is the top position, so no probe. Latency target 1 (100; 300 is above) equals LOW-SPEED, which holds. EOWs: 0x8A7, 0x9A4, 0xB04, then 0x8A7, 0x9A4, 0xAFF repeated, 21 in all, the transmission of drc-rx-clean-burst-holds-against-estimate. Before corpus 0.34.0 any errored burst let the estimate move MAX-SPEED down, here to WN 4 Long (drc-rx-errored-burst-estimate-moves-down, which now has a burst over the limit).
